description: This file defines an interface for interacting with Amazon DynamoDB sessions, outlining methods for reading, writing, deleting, and cleaning up session data.

classes.name: SessionConnectionInterface
classes.description: An interface specifying methods for session storage interactions with DynamoDB, including read, write, delete, and garbage collection.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads session data from DynamoDB given a session ID.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes session data to DynamoDB with a given session ID, serialized data, and change indicator.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a session record from DynamoDB identified by session ID.

methods.name: deleteExpired
methods.description: Performs garbage collection to delete expired sessions from DynamoDB.
